title: Inviting Singaporean Researchers who have Received Prestigious Awards Abroad to Return to Work in Research Institutions
what_it_is: Inviting Singaporean Researchers who have Received Prestigious Awards Abroad to Return to Work in Research Institutions

sections.label: Schemes for returning Singaporean researchers
sections.summary: The Government and Autonomous Universities have schemes, such as NRF's Returning Singaporean Scientist Scheme, to help overseas-based Singaporeans return to contribute.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For those who are based overseas and are inclined to return to Singapore to contribute, the Government and Autonomous Universities (AUs) have various schemes in place to facilitate their transition, such as National Research Foundation (NRF)'s Returning Singaporean Scientist Scheme (RSSS).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: We are mindful, however, that attracting overseas-based Singaporean researchers back to the local AUs depends on a convergence of different factors.

sections.label: Overseas researchers collaboration and SGN
sections.summary: Overseas Singaporean researchers can collaborate with local AUs or A*STAR RIs, and link up with SGN for events and information.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Even if the Singaporean researcher prefers to remain overseas, there are opportunities for collaborations with the local AUs or our A*STAR Research Institutes (RIs) if there are common research interests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Overseas Singaporeans, including researchers, can also link up with the Singapore Global Network (SGN) within the Economic Development Board (EDB).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: SGN organises digital engagement and community events to keep overseas Singaporeans connected to home, so that they can make an informed decision about whether and when to return to Singapore.
